svg.title: Revera: review outcomes by task
svg.desc: rv-commander15-negate: Exa bug found, bug found, bug found; Parallel bug found; Tavily bug found; Brave bug found; Firecrawl bug found, bug found, bug found; No search bug missed, bug missed, bug missed. rv-got16-http2-agent: Exa bug found, bug found, bug found; Parallel bug found; Tavily bug found; Brave bug found; Firecrawl bug found, bug found, bug found; No search bug missed, bug missed, bug missed. rv-got16-migrate: Exa clean, clean, clean; Parallel strict finding; Tavily strict finding; Brave strict finding; Firecrawl clean, clean, strict finding; No search clean, clean, clean. rv-ky2-migrate: Exa clean; Parallel clean; Tavily clean; Brave clean; Firecrawl clean; No search clean. Amber dots mark additional uncertain comments. Strict clean-control findings were adjudicated not hallucinations.
svg.text: Quick pass + confirmation reps · one marker per run, in source order · unequal repetitions
